scope: Prerequisite review of five pinned original workflow documents; not five frozen tasks or completed executions.
evidence_locator: Recovered object files are indexed by Git blob in the external study cache. Citations specify blob and original line numbers.
availability_caveat: Inspected bundle indices did not list matching SDK binaries or packaged fixtures. This does not prove that no usable public or other local inputs exist.

sources.workflow: Build native Android contact-center chat, video, virtual-agent or scheduled-callback integration with lifecycle cleanup.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Channel entry identifier or callback API key; SDK initialization, listeners and launch order.
sources.live_goal: Service-dependent engagement; not independently executable offline.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Integration build and lifecycle-contract test if compatible Android SDK artifacts and controlled inputs can be supplied.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Initialization, channel identifiers, listeners, launch ordering, failure handling and cleanup. Live engagement needs separate evidence.

sources.workflow: Embed the full-page meeting interface, initialize, join and handle operations and events.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Installed SDK, backend signature, meeting identifier, display name and password; role and registration credentials when applicable.
sources.live_goal: An actual meeting join cannot be established offline.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Payload construction and lifecycle implementation tests with controlled SDK interfaces and available local browser assets; not a successful meeting join.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Initialization order, required and conditional fields, omission of empty optional fields, callbacks, event handling and cleanup.

sources.workflow: Build a native macOS meeting app with authentication, attendee join or host start and meeting controllers.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Backend signature, successful SDK authentication, meeting identifier and passcode; host token and role-aware signature for host start.
sources.live_goal: Real join and start are service-dependent.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Native build and delegate/lifecycle testing if the platform and compatible SDK are available. A document's historical local-package claim does not establish present availability.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Secret handling, authentication before join, role-specific parameters, delegate ordering, leave/end and cleanup; live behavior remains unverified.

sources.workflow: Implement a phone integration using an embed, service API or external launch; handle events, identifiers, migrations and validation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Phone licensing and administration, SMS readiness when relevant, OAuth application/scopes, origin and webhook-signature validation.
sources.live_goal: Actual calls, account data and live event delivery require the service.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Embed bridge implementation and controlled-message tests without a live account. Controlled events are not evidence of real calls.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Readiness ordering, origin validation, payloads, event routing, identifier correlation, deduplication and unknown events.

sources.workflow: Authenticate to the connector, list accessible whiteboards, choose the correct identifier and retrieve the selected whiteboard.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: User OAuth with the stated read scopes and an access token; server-to-server tool execution needs separate validation.
sources.live_goal: The stated list-and-get workflow needs the service and authorized accessible data.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Identifier selection and list-to-get contract tests only; these cannot establish successful retrieval or authorization.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Authorized service responses and expected whiteboard identity/content for the actual goal. Do not infer response shape from a tool name.
